issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

nodeCountAllowedRange.description:
The permitted range for {@link App.NodePool.Config#minNodeCount} and {@link App.NodePool.Config#maxNodeCount}
Value of -1 indicates there are no limits.

deploymentStrategy.description:
Specifies the deployment strategy to be used.
NOTE: Effects the deployment strategy only when new replicaset is created, and not during disruptions on the pod directly.
NOTE: For SNE backed by PVC, deploymentStrategy will always be `Recreate` and nodePool config won't be respected.

Possible values:
- 'RollingUpdate': Gradually replace old pods belonging to old replicaset with new ones.
- 'Recreate': Terminate all pods of previous replicaset before creating pods of the new replicaset.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description:
Specifies the max duration in seconds that the system will wait before forcefully terminating a node in this {@link App.NodePool}.
This allows for graceful shutdown of processes running on the node.
NOTE: The terminationGracePeriodSeconds will affect the time it takes for the node to scale down,
      hence increasing it will slowdown upgrades, nodePool scale downs, restarts and other such operations.
NOTE: For HardwareAvailability.LOW, this value won't be respected by the underline cloud provider.

doNotEvict.description:
Setting this flag to true prevents eviction of the underlying infrastructure node by the cloud provider cluster autoscalers.
Note: This is a powerful feature and should be used with caution. Setting this to true will incur additional costs
and may lead to under-utilization of resources. This should only be used when the c3 node is required to run critical workloads.

hardwareProfile.description: Refers to {@link HardwareProfile} object for nodes of this {@link App.NodePool}.

targetNodeCount.description: Refers to the target node count for this {@link App.NodePool}.

minNodeCount.description:
Refers to the minimum node count for this {@link App.NodePool}. Note that the target node count cannot be below
this configured value for safety measures. This value must be reconfigured first for the target node count to go
lower.

maxNodeCount.description:
Refers to the maximum node count for this {@link App.NodePool}. Note that the target node count cannot be above
this configured value for safety measures. This value must be reconfigured first for the target node count to go
higher.

membership.description: Refers to {@link App.NodePool.Membership} for this {@link App.NodePool}.

roles.description: Refers to all {@link Server.Role}s for this {@link App.NodePool}.

autoScale.description: Refers to {@link App.NodePool.AutoscaleSpec} to be used for this {@link App.NodePool}.

jvm.description: Refers to {@link App.NodePool.JvmSpec} to be used for this {@link App.NodePool}.

sharedStorage.description: Refers to {@link App.NodePool.Config.SharedStorage} to enable shared storage for a node pool

volumeSizeMapping.description:
A map of {@link App.NodePool.Config.Volumes} and size ( eg. 2Gi ) to configure volume
size for a {@link App.NodePool}.

queues.description:
The config that defines the thresholds for queue rule-based resource governance based on
a node's {@link App.NodePool.Config}. Whenever this field is updated, users need to restart their nodepool's nodes
for these new settings to effect.

stopped.description: Refers to whether this NodePool is stopped or not.

pyInterpreterPool.description:
Refers to {@link App.NodePool.PyInterpreterPoolSpec} to configure pool of persisted
python interpreters for this {@link App.NodePool}.

name: App.NodePool.Config
